newsitem.title: USA: Valero to pursue strategic options.
newsitem.headline: Valero to pursue strategic options.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said on Thursday that its board approved a company recommendation to review strategic alternatives, including seeking an alliance for its natural gas related services unit and a likely spin-off of its refining and marketing operation.

The company also said Joe Becraft, who suggested the course of action to the board, submitted his resignation as president and chief executive officer. Chairman Bill Greehey would assume the additional role of CEO, it said.
Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Ed Benninger, was promoted to the position of president, it said.

Becraft said he believed the proposed strategy was in the company's best interests, but the spin-off of the refining and marketing operations did not align with his own experience in the natural gas field.
Valero Energy said it would accelerate existing effort to seek a "strategic alliance" for its natural gas related services business.
It would also likely spin-off its refining and marketing operation as a separate company headquartered in San Antonio, it said.

Valero said that, while it had made no formal commitment to proceed with any alliance, it would solicit potential strategic partners to see if an alliance could provide significant additional value to Valero's shareholders.
Lehman Brothers Inc had been retained to assist in soliciting indications of interest, it said.
